About_&_Key_Points:
About
Indian Oil Corporation Ltd is a Maharatna Company controlled by GOI
[1]
that has business interests straddling the entire hydrocarbon value chain - from Refining, Pipeline transportation and marketing of Petroleum products to R&D, Exploration & production, marketing of natural gas and petrochemicals.
It has the leadership position in the Oil refining & petroleum marketing sector of India.
